invariants.text: Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The total quantity of products in a category must not exceed the sum of individual product quantities within that category.
When a product is filtered by category, only products that belong to that category are included in the result set.
When products are filtered by a quantity threshold, only those products with a quantity strictly less than the threshold are returned.
Adding a product to the inventory must ensure that the product's price is greater than zero.
Updating a product's quantity must ensure that the new quantity is non-negative.
Deleting a product must remove it from the inventory and reduce the total quantity of products in its category by its original quantity.
The sum of the prices of all products in a category must equal the total price value of all products in that category.
The quantity of a product must be updated only if the new value is greater than or equal to zero.
A product must have a unique name within its category to avoid duplication.
The product category must be one of the predefined valid categories when creating or updating a product.
